ADR-0111/personal-agent-scope.rule: Codex agent installation defaults to the personal agent directory, keeps project installation explicit, and preserves the reserved namespace, no-clobber, and containment guarantees at either scope.

ADR-0112/personal-codex-agents-are-dogfo.rule: The Crux development checkout carries no project-local Codex agent projection; personal agents are its dogfood configuration, while project installation remains an explicit user choice.

ADR-0113/per-agent-codex-runtime-overrid.rule: An agent may carry a complete Codex runtime override only when an Accepted ADR authorizes the exception; otherwise Codex resolves from its level, and both paths pass the same validation and provenance rules.
